# ValhallaFit

> Client-retention and coaching platform for personal trainers: keep clients training, engaged, and showing measurable progress between sessions — not just during them.

ValhallaFit gives personal trainers a web workspace to plan, review, and prove client progress over time, and gives clients a mobile-friendly experience to follow their plan and log sets in the gym on any day, with or without the trainer present.

## Positioning

ValhallaFit is built for trainers whose priority is retention, engagement, and community rather than lead generation. It is not a marketplace and does not sell trainers leads. The product exists to reduce client drop-off by making progress visible, keeping training structured between sessions, and giving trainers a record of what each client actually did.

## What ValhallaFit does

- Reusable weekly workout plans clients can start on any day, so training continues between booked sessions
- Workout plan builder with target reps, sets, and weights per exercise, plus alternative exercises with their own targets
- Exercise library of 100+ movements tagged with primary and secondary muscle groups
- Client session logging from a phone in the gym: sets, reps, and weights
- Trainer review with target-versus-actual performance deltas, so progress is provable rather than remembered
- Client management: assign plans, review history, archive clients
- In development: weekly client check-ins, long-term progress reports, and community features

## Who it is for

Independent personal trainers and online coaches who coach a roster of clients and care about keeping them long term. Typical questions ValhallaFit answers: how do I stop clients dropping off, how do I keep clients engaged between sessions, how do I show a client the progress they have made, how do I run a coaching business without spreadsheets.

## Key facts

- Product type: web application for trainers, mobile-friendly web experience for clients
- Access: trainers apply for an account; the product is in active development with an early-access list
- Data recorded per session: exercises performed, sets, reps, weight, and comparison against the prescribed target
